tool_input.command:
cd "/d/Github/WYR Web/server/src" && python - <<'EOF'
p = "stock.js"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
a = """export async function logStockMovement(db, { variantId, delta, reason, orderId = null, note = null }) {
  if (!delta) return;
  await db.stockMovement.create({ data: { variantId, delta, reason, orderId, note: note?.slice(0, 255) ?? null } });"""
assert a in s
s = s.replace(a, """export async function logStockMovement(db, { variantId, delta, reason, orderId = null, documentId = null, note = null }) {
  if (!delta) return;
  await db.stockMovement.create({ data: { variantId, delta, reason, orderId, documentId, note: note?.slice(0, 255) ?? null } });""")
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(s)

p = "app.js"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
s = s.replace('import { adminCostingRouter } from "./routes/admin-costing.js";\n', 'import { adminCostingRouter } from "./routes/admin-costing.js";\nimport { adminDocumentsRouter } from "./routes/admin-documents.js";\n', 1)
s = s.replace('  app.use("/api/admin/vouchers", adminVouchersRouter);\n', '  app.use("/api/admin/vouchers", adminVouchersRouter);\n  app.use("/api/admin/documents", adminDocumentsRouter);\n', 1)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(s)
EOF
grep -n "documents" app.js
